description.value:
Gimmicks are small devices designed to be harnessed by magic users, available in any number of designs. When you purchase a gimmick, you choose a theme that applies to all spells you cast while holding it, though it doesn't change their effects. For example, a gambler's @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Force Barrage] might resemble throwing cards. You can reprogram a gimmick during your daily preparations to alter its theme. Some gimmicks can also apply additional effects by activating them before Casting a Spell.

This colorful gimmick is especially popular with spellcasters who have a preference for a particular element. When you purchase this gimmick or when you reprogram it during your daily preparations, choose an elemental trait: air (electricity or slashing), earth (bludgeoning or piercing), fire (fire), metal (piercing or slashing), radiation (acid or poison), water (bludgeoning or cold), and wood (piercing or vitality).

Activate—Gimmick! 1 (magical, spellshape)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect If your next action is to Cast a Spell with an elemental trait (as listed above), replace it with the chosen trait and replace one of its damage types with one of the damage types associated with your chosen trait.
